eyebrow: A design problem, not a personal one

steps.label: Alerting on causes
steps.sub: CPU >80% fires even when nothing user-facing breaks

steps.label: Non-actionable alerts
steps.sub: nothing to do trains people to dismiss on reflex

steps.label: No grouping
steps.sub: one cause, twelve pages, looks like twelve problems

steps.label: Alert on symptoms
steps.sub: checkout latency, not CPU -- what users feel

steps.label: Every page is actionable
steps.sub: something to do right now, or it's not a page

steps.label: Group & deduplicate
steps.sub: one incident, not one alert per affected service

code:
# Noisy: fires on every short blip
error_rate > 0.01   for: 1m

# Better: fires only when burning the
# error budget fast enough to matter
error_budget_burn_rate > 14.4   for: 5m
severity: page
caption: A burn-rate alert ignores blips that recover and catches real sustained risk.

subtitle: Everything in this course, applied to something you build
